title: The Assayer
pages:
The gold runs in a seam through the blackstone, thicker the deeper you cut. An assayer went down before me to weigh it.

He dug loudly. That is the whole of his mistake, and it cannot be unmade.

The seam heard him. It answered with a tremor, then with footsteps that were not his. His scale still hangs in the last chamber, and it still weighs.

I dug quietly, where the gold was thin. The loud veins are his now.
